text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein and Oman's Sultan Qaboos discuss bilateral ties and regional issues; discussions cover cooperation and latest Middle East peace developments.

- Crown Prince Hassan inaugurates a new $85 million joint venture with Japan; says scheme to transform the Red Sea port of Aqaba into a free zone area is major development project to attract investments.
- A shootout in the middle of Amman between police and Iraqi robbers; an exchange dealer and an officer injured but police managed to return back 100,000 dinars ($141,242) of stolen money.
- Hamas spokesman says Islamic Resistance movement did not conclude a deal in return for the release of its jailed leader Musa Abu Marzook.
- Crown Prince inaugurates Jordanian-Japanese fertiliser factory; says joint venture is result of Japan's trust in Jordan's investment environment.
- King congratulates new British PM Blair.
